question: The doldrums are an area of ________ pressure around the equator, where prevailing winds are calm.
solution:
The correct answer is __**low**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The doldrums are an area of **low pressure** around the equator.
 
• This region is characterized by **calm prevailing winds**, which can lead to periods of no wind at all.
 
• The calm conditions are caused by the **convergence of trade winds** from both the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
 
• The doldrums are known for their unpredictable weather and can pose challenges for maritime navigation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The doldrums are also referred to as the **Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)**.
 
• This zone migrates with the seasons, moving north during the Northern Hemisphere summer and south during the Northern Hemisphere winter.
 
• The doldrums can significantly impact global weather patterns and are linked to the formation of tropical storms.
